WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{glueAreaMachine.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{glueAreaMachine.glue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} glue, #{glueAreaMachine.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_code FROM dual
) SELECT ifnull(MIX_AREA, '') AS MIX_AREA, ifnull(RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE, '') AS MACHINE_CODE, ifnull(RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, '') AS GLUE, LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT AS WEIGHT FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE WHERE DEL_FLAG='0' AND RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态；在用*/ AND AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志 ：已审核*/
AND RECIPE_TYPE = #{recipeType} /*配方类型*/
AND (RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME) IN (SELECT GLUE FROM temp_table)
order by (case when regexp_like(RECIPE_TYPE,'^[0-9]+$') then RECIPE_TYPE + 0 else 9999999 end) desc, (case when regexp_like(RECIPE_VERSION_ID,'^[0-9]+$') then RECIPE_VERSION_ID + 0 else -1 end)

WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{material.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material_name FROM dual
) SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL WHERE 1=1
AND MATERIAL_NAME IN (SELECT MATERIAL_NAME FROM temp_table)
AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT RECIPE_TYPE_CODE, MAX(RECIPE_TYPE_NAME) RECIPE_TYPE_NAME FROM T_RECIPE_TYPE WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY RECIPE_TYPE_CODE

SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0'
and IS_HIGH_CONSUMPTION = #{isHighConsumption}

SELECT R.ID, R.RECIPE_ID, R.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE, R.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, R.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, R.RECIPE_VERSION_ID, R.RECIPE_TYPE, R.PRODUCT_STAGE, ifnull(R.SUMMER_MIX_TIME, 0) SUMMER_MIX_TIME, ifnull(R.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT, 0) LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT, W.ID AS WEIGHTID, W.SET_WEIGHT, W.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AS WEIGHT_MATERIAL_CODE, W.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AS WEIGHT_MATERIAL_NAME, B2.MAJOR_TYPE AS WEIGHT_MAJOR_TYPE, ROUND(ifnull(W.SET_WEIGHT / R2.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT, 1), 4) CONVERSION_RATIO FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R LEFT JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE_WEIGHT W ON R.RECIPE_ID = W.FATHER_RECIPE_ID AND W.Del_Flag = '0' AND W.SET_WEIGHT IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL B2 ON B2.MATERIAL_CODE = W.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND B2.Del_Flag = '0' LEFT JOIN (SELECT MIN(LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT) LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT, RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R2 WHERE R2.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R2.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R2.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (R2.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND (R2.RECIPE_TYPE = '1' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R3 WHERE R3.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND R3.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R3.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R3.RECIPE_TYPE = '1' AND R3.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R3.MIX_AREA = R2.MIX_AREA)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R3 WHERE R3.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND R3.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R3.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R3.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R3.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea})) GROUP BY RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE) R2 ON R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = W.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE WHERE R.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' and B2.MAJOR_TYPE = '3' AND R.mix_area = #{mixArea} order by R.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE, R.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, R.RECIPE_VERSION_ID
